posts.text:
Mini Jev is open source: a local API reading frozen Qwen logits for choices, true/false scores, and ordinal scores without generating answer text. Includes 2,400 self-authored Japanese eval items and optional head-training experiments.

https://github.com/UpHash-Network/mini-jev

Developed with AI agents. The 2,400-item suite is self-authored, not an external benchmark. In a separate 1.5B experiment, residual-head training reduced held-out accuracy from 73/96 to 67/96. Matched generation baselines remain future work.

Mini Jevを公開しました。LLMから文章を生成せず、選択肢・真偽・段階スコアを返すAPIです。自分のデータで補正headを学習・評価するツールも同梱。自作日本語2,400問の結果と失敗例を公開しています。本家Jevとは独立した実装です。

https://github.com/UpHash-Network/mini-jev
